rows.grounds: object of omission in the yoni-pit
object of exclusion in the lotus

items.question: Which elements must be omitted within the yoni-pit and within the lotus?
premises: The yoni-pit is a specified locus.
The yoni is to be omitted in the yoni-pit.
The lotus is a specified locus.
The navel is to be excluded in the lotus.
items.inference: Different diagrammatic loci require omitting distinct elements, namely the yoni in the yoni-pit and the navel in the lotus.
uncertainties: The precise diagrammatic referents of yonikuṇḍa and abja depend on the broader ritual or geometric context.
items.plain_english: In the yoni-pit one should omit the yoni, and in the lotus one should exclude the navel.
